planning_scope: Rank only policy-legal physical candidates for the currently supported TrustAero IR and DuckDB backend fragment.

candidate_work_features.name: scan_rows_by_pipeline
candidate_work_features.meaning: Rows scanned by each physical pipeline rather than total logical-table rows.

candidate_work_features.name: active_columns_by_operator
candidate_work_features.meaning: Columns actually required by an operator; unused logical columns must not contribute payload cost.

candidate_work_features.name: join_build_probe_output_rows
candidate_work_features.meaning: Separate build, probe, and output cardinalities for each Join.

candidate_work_features.name: join_key_bytes
candidate_work_features.meaning: Key width multiplied by the relevant Join-side cardinality.

candidate_work_features.name: mask_rows_and_value_bytes
candidate_work_features.meaning: Rows and source-value bytes that reach Mask at its actual placement.

candidate_work_features.name: raw_materialization_rows_and_bytes
candidate_work_features.meaning: Active raw columns written and reread at an explicit pipeline boundary.

candidate_work_features.name: masked_materialization_rows_and_bytes
candidate_work_features.meaning: Masked schema written and reread at an explicit pipeline boundary.

candidate_work_features.name: aggregate_input_rows_and_state
candidate_work_features.meaning: Rows reaching aggregation and an operator-specific state descriptor.

candidate_work_features.name: sort_rows_and_key_bytes
candidate_work_features.meaning: Rows and active key bytes reaching Sort after prior reductions.

candidate_work_features.name: result_rows_and_payload_bytes
candidate_work_features.meaning: Rows and active columns emitted by the candidate.

candidate_work_features.name: lineage_rows_edges_and_payload
candidate_work_features.meaning: Rows, dependency edges, and evidence payload required by the physical lineage instrumentation.

candidate_work_features.name: pipeline_breaker_count_and_kind
candidate_work_features.meaning: Explicit materialization, blocking aggregate, or Sort boundaries; their effects are operator- and downstream-task-specific.

calibration_rule: Calibrate component throughput and fixed costs with isolated operator microbenchmarks. The analytic layer estimates every legal candidate in the same units before ranking.
residual_rule: A lightweight residual model may be added only after the analytic implementation and calibration protocol are frozen. It predicts remaining analytic error, never legality and never the winner directly.

uncertainty_rule.out_of_calibration_range: fall back to the frozen conservative legal candidate
uncertainty_rule.top_two_cost_gap_within_practical_tie: treat candidates as performance-equivalent and use the frozen stable legal preference
uncertainty_rule.clear_in_range_cost_gap: select the lowest estimated-cost legal candidate

prohibited_shortcuts: use full logical row width as Join payload width
use one global row-width feature for every pipeline
add a family-specific exception after seeing a result
describe logical byte estimates as DuckDB telemetry
rank or execute a policy-illegal candidate
reuse consumed Phase 2G as an independent holdout
required_next_artifact: A reviewed feature extractor with unit tests proving column pruning, candidate-specific Mask rows, materialization work, downstream operator work, and fail-closed legality behavior.
